Sar e Bazar Pursa Tha Yehi Bas Parda Daron Ka
Ajab Hai Qafila Zainab Tere Naiza Sawaron Ka
Dikha Kar Zakhm Kano Ke Sakina Maa Se Kehti Thi
Jo Wapis Mil Gaye Tu Kya Karon Gi Goshwaron Ka
Ajab Andaz Mein Quraan Haya Ka Sham Mein Pohancha
Har Ik Parah Alag Naizay Pe Aaya Tees Paroon Ka
Khari Hain Aurtein Pathar Uthaye Apne Hathoon Mein
Yeh Istaqbal Hai Ibn-e-Ali Ke Sogawaron Ka
Aseeri Ki Manadi Karne Walo Phir Karo Ayelaan
Koi Zindan Mein Mara Gaya Hai Gham Ke Maron Ka
Sadaein Uth Rahi Thin Har Taraf Se Maro Maro Ki
Madine Tak Gaya Tha Shoor AKBAR Unn Ke Naron Ka
